decisive_question: Can Prometheus independently validate not only whether the underlying facts are true, but whether the economic relationship connecting those facts is actually justified by the evidence?
answer: YES — with known over-rejection limitation on borderline SUPPORTED positive controls. The reviewer detects 100% of semantic causal violations (7/7) and produces 0 false accepts across 11 adversarial cases. It correctly auto-accepts PLAUSIBLE interpretations with explicit qualifiers (ADV-12 ACCEPT) and preserves UNKNOWN relationships as uncertainty.

scope_constraints.mode: shadow mode — no production composer changes

architecture.design: analogous to existing claim AI reviewer but operates at relationship level
8_validation_dimensions: ENDPOINT_VALIDITY: both claims supported by cited evidence
CHRONOLOGY: cause must temporally precede effect
LINKAGE: evidence establishes direct connection beyond co-occurrence
RETROSPECTIVE_BIAS: management attribution ≠ independent causal proof
ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATIONS: unresolved alternatives cap confidence at PLAUSIBLE
MEASUREMENT_WINDOW: sufficient elapsed time for effect to be observable
CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION: recommended confidence vs proposed confidence
architecture.evidence_index: built from integrated package sections; includes ai_reasoning_guidance.must_not_assert annotations
architecture.prose_extraction: scans narrative fields for undeclared causal language

CONFIRMED.accept: verdict=SUPPORTED AND chronology_valid AND linkage_established AND no causal_issues AND no measurement_window AND no retrospective_bias
CONFIRMED.reject_path: REJECT if UNSUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED verdict or causal_issues present

SUPPORTED.accept: verdict in (SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED) AND chronology_valid AND not measurement_window AND not retrospective_bias AND no hard_overstatement

PLAUSIBLE.accept: verdict in (SUPPORTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED) AND chronology_valid AND has_interpretation_frame
PLAUSIBLE.note: measurement_window is NOT a hard block — PLAUSIBLE framing already acknowledges uncertainty
